type_text:
∀ (src : ℕ → ℕ) (cont : ℕ → Bool),
  (∀ (k : ℕ), src k ≤ k) →
    (∀ (k : ℕ), cont k = true → 0 < k ∧ src k = src (k - 1)) →
      ∀ (k : ℕ),
        ∃ a,
          src k ≤ a ∧
            a ≤ k ∧
              (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainTree src cont).repr (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainAux src cont k) =
                  (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainTree src cont).repr (2 * src k) +
                    Multiset.map (fun i => 2 * i) (Finset.Ico a k).val ∧
                (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainTree src cont).depth
                      (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainAux src cont k) =
                    src k + (k - a) ∧
                  2 * src k ∈
                    (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainTree src cont).ancestors
                      (OracleTemplate.BirchMethods.chainAux src cont k)
